items.headline: Garrison Rippa makes field goal with 51 seconds left as Jacksonville State tops Kennesaw State 27-26
items.description: — Garrison Rippa made a go-ahead field goal in the final minute, and Rob Billings IV intercepted a pass seconds later as Jacksonville State beat Kennesaw State 27-26 on Wednesday night in a rematch of the 2025 Conference USA championship game.

items.headline: Jacksonville State takes on Kennesaw State in CUSA play
items.description: Jacksonville State (3-2) at Kennesaw State (1-3), Oct. 7 at 7 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Creel's 241 yards passing, 119 rushing yards give Jacksonville State 23-13 win over Middle Tennessee
items.description: — Caden Creel threw for 241 yards and ran for 119 more as Jacksonville State beat Middle Tennessee 23-13 on Saturday in the Conference USA opener for both teams.
